title: fix: preserve file attachments during pane refresh
body: Fixes #188067. ## What Problem This Solves Attaching an open file from **Files → More file actions → Attach to session** could silently produce no draft attachment if the pane refreshed during its download. Resizing the browser is one reproducible trigger, even when the selected file, destination session and access remain unchanged. An immediate-download control worked; the failure was in retaining the accepted action across refresh. ## User Impact The selected file can finish attaching to the existing message draft while the pane refreshes. Existing message text and attachments remain intact, and the action still sends nothing automatically. Actual source, session, read-owner, connection or authority replacement keeps the existing cancellation behavior. Original file bytes, unsaved-editor text, upload permissions and attachment size limits continue through their existing owners. ## Why This Change Was Made The attachment operation compares callback identities before the next UI frame commits. Both composer destination callbacks and the artifact-download resolver were recreated during every pane render, so equivalent frames looked like different owners. Keep the composer callbacks for their captured state, read lifecycle and read signal, and keep the artifact resolver for its captured state. Changing those owners replaces the callbacks; changing attachment membership, limits or availability still produces current values. This preserves the operation's cancellation checks instead of removing them. The two existing producers retain one current binding each, with no new global cache or lifecycle service. ## Evidence The complete browser flow failed on the base when a file-download response was held through a real pane resize: the selected file and authority fields stayed equal, all four callback identities changed, and no attachment appeared. A separate live saved-file reproduction held delivery of the actual HTTP 200 response, resized, then released the same 786 bytes; it produced the same missing attachment while preserving existing unsent work. The regression extends the existing Files → Attach → Send scenario with that held read and resize, plus assertions for unchanged draft text and no automatic send. Existing original-byte, unsaved-editor, cancellation and composer-handoff checks remain in scope. The implementation adds 34 production lines and 9 regression lines; the allocation record covers only those 9 test lines. Changed-file formatting/lint, UI catalog checks and all selected type graphs passed. The nine selected test files reported 185 passing test cases, including the complete four-scenario workspace browser file and 22 composer-handoff tests. The browser file took 19.70 seconds including its 9.80-second build. The ordinary UI test process additionally reported an uncaught Node fetch-abort error in the unchanged attachment suite; the untouched base reproduced the identical exception with the same 159 test cases passing. That inherited failure remains disclosed rather than reported as a green aggregate; it is tracked separately in #188084. The corrected live pending-read case attached the file once while preserving an existing attachment and unsent text. Native file navigation, saved-session replacement and connection retirement canceled pending reads; returning or reconnecting preserved the existing draft. An explicit message then sent the selected file with its original SHA-256, alongside the existing context attachment, and the completed reply used both to answer the planning question. The live UI was built from the exact PR head against an unchanged isolated Gateway with the same affected download contract. Exact-head hosted CI is green. Local AutoReview covered the committed range from faa38148 to 07da80ac at P0–P3 and found no actionable issues. Independent engineering review is clean. [ClawSweeper’s exact-head review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/188075#issuecomment-6514597718) has no findings and rates the patch Platinum with Gold overall proof; the live capture it requested is included below. ## Visual evidence []() | Before | After | | --- | --- | | ![After the interrupted baseline read, only the existing context\.txt attachment remains\.](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/dbac7f60-e108-4349-880d-135a0804af2b) | ![After resize and download completion, notes\.md joins context\.txt and the draft text remains\.](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7ad796da-f7f4-44a0-a127-dd9c63deb3e9) | ### Exact\-head Files action, pending read, resize, and completed draft attachment https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7ef91b72-306e-4ec5-b741-78f310c625d7 ### Visual verification - Baseline: faa38148f2c5ba3fe8f69bd3ae0150c87edf7758 - Exact head: `07da80ac7122b46431b46eddee8523fcd7dfedea` - Scenario: Attach notes\.md from Files while its real download is pending, resize the browser, and preserve existing unsent text and context\.txt\. Images use the same crop from a 1440×1000 desktop viewport\. - Runtime/build: Control UI 2026\.10\.9\-07da80ac7122; compatible isolated Gateway 9ca944e298b7\. Source\-built UI with original authorized file bytes\. - Authorized original file: 786 bytes; identical SHA\-256 before and after - Added attachment: Before 0; after exactly 1 notes\.md - Existing draft: context\.txt and unsent text preserved - Automatic sends: 0 - Original\-resolution before and after images inspected; same file, draft, viewport, theme and crop\. - Focused 8\.24\-second recording inspected across its full timeline, with full\-size menu and result frames\. - Real HTTP response held during resize; no synthetic replacement bytes\. - Production cancellation checks retained; independent review clean\.
